complete_separate_delivery_screen.proof: For 0<t<1, sum r_i^t >= (sum r_i)^t. Beating H7 needs sum r_i<=6. Zero-rank observations are already in the ordinary quotient. There are at most two rank-one answers. With zero rank-one answers, at most three rank-two-or-larger jobs fit; the only three-job profile is (2,2,2). With k=1 or 2 selected rank-one answers, at most two remaining rank>=2 jobs fit. All cases are checked.
